threat_event: Malicious script injected into the checkout page skims card data typed into the embedded payment form (e-commerce skimming)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 third-party scripts on the checkout page with no inventory, authorization, or integrity check; no payment-page change or tamper detection
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 checkout page; SYS-02 embedded payment form
existing_controls: Processor's embedded payment form; storefront vendor's web application firewall
treatment_plan: Script inventory with written justification and approval; remove the tag manager from checkout; script integrity and content security policy settings; payment-page change and tamper detection with alerts to the IT Manager

threat_event: Marketing contractor's storefront account taken over and used to add a malicious tag
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor uses a local storefront administrator account with no MFA and full administrator rights, including script and tag changes
treatment_plan: Move the contractor to single sign-on with MFA; limit the role to content editing with no script, theme code, or app rights

threat_event: Loyalty export spreadsheet leaked or reused by the marketing contractor
threat_source: Service provider, or an attacker in its email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full member exports emailed monthly as unencrypted attachments; no contract terms on security, data use, or deletion
treatment_plan: Stop emailed exports; provide segment files without phone numbers or emails through an access-controlled share; sign a data use and security addendum

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from an office PC to the POS back office and refrigeration controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IoT devices and the POS back office reachable from the corporate network; shared POS administrator account; signature antivirus only
existing_controls: POS VLAN managed by the POS vendor; guest Wi-Fi separated
treatment_plan: Put IoT devices and the POS back office on their own VLANs with deny-by-default rules; endpoint detection and response on office PCs; offline copy of the nightly price file

threat_event: Refrigeration controllers altered or disabled through the contractor's always-on remote access tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote access with a shared login; controllers on the corporate network
treatment_plan: On-demand remote access with named accounts, MFA, and Store Manager approval; move controllers to the IoT VLAN

threat_event: Shared POS back office administrator account misused for refund fraud, price overrides, or to re-enable manual card entry and break P2PE scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared administrator account used by managers and vendor technicians; password unchanged since 2022; no review of configuration changes
existing_controls: Back office in a locked office
treatment_plan: Change the password now; named accounts for each manager and vendor technician; monthly check that manual card entry is still disabled

threat_event: PIN pad at self-checkout swapped or fitted with an overlay skimmer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inspections not scheduled or recorded; device list not reconciled with the processor's inventory
existing_controls: P2PE devices are tamper-responsive; cashier skimmer awareness at hire
treatment_plan: Daily self-checkout and weekly lane inspection log; reconcile serial numbers with the processor; annual cashier refresher

threat_event: Acquirer treats the company as non-compliant after an incident because the 2025 SAQs were attested without evidence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAQs signed without scoping or evidence; script-attack eligibility criterion attested without support; no scope document
treatment_plan: Evidence-based 2026 SAQs; written scope and data-flow document; optional QSA review before signing

threat_event: Former employees use storefront administrator accounts that were never removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 former employees active (found in P07 testing); no termination checklist for the storefront
treatment_plan: Storefront administration through single sign-on only; same-day disable from the HR ticket; quarterly account review

threat_event: Card compromise handled late: the acquirer is not told within 24 hours and evidence is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; staff unaware of the merchant agreement notice term
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; forensic firm through the insurer; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over online shopping accounts and places fraudulent orders with saved card tokens
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default login settings; bot protection options not reviewed; no alert on new-device sign-in
treatment_plan: Turn on the vendor's bot protection and login rate limits; breached-password check; new-device email alert

threat_event: Phishing gives an attacker an office mailbox holding loyalty exports and a path to the storefront
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training for office staff; exports kept in mailboxes
treatment_plan: Annual training and quarterly phishing exercises for office staff; delete exports from mailboxes

threat_event: Loyalty database cannot be restored after ransomware or an administrator error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in the same cloud account and role as production; never restore-tested
treatment_plan: Copy backups to a separate account with immutable retention; quarterly restore test

threat_event: Loyalty exports exposed through a misconfigured cloud storage container
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Old exports kept in object storage; account-level public access block not verified; no configuration alerts
treatment_plan: Enforce the account-level public access block; delete exports older than 90 days; alert on storage policy changes

threat_event: Dynamic pricing raises online prices in lower-income delivery zones, leading to an unfairness claim and loss of trust
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Delivery-zone feature in the price model; no fairness testing before launch
existing_controls: Prices bounded at plus or minus 15% of shelf price
treatment_plan: Zone feature disabled 2026-08-28; monthly fairness tests by ZIP code and delivery zone (P10)

threat_event: Personalized savings and reference price claims cannot be substantiated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of pricing claims; no substantiation file
treatment_plan: Claims review checklist; keep substantiation for each savings and reference price claim

threat_event: Privacy notice says loyalty data is never shared, while exports go to a contractor and the pricing vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice written in 2019 and not updated for new vendors
treatment_plan: Rewrite the notice to describe service providers and personalized offers; align practices

threat_event: Refrigeration sensor or controller failure goes unnoticed overnight and stock spoils
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alerts go only to one email address
treatment_plan: Text alerts to the Store Manager and assistant manager on call; local audible alarm

threat_event: Internet outage stops card authorization, online ordering, and loyalty lookups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider; no offline card mode configured
regulatory_driver: Operational; N44-45-R01 (P2PE solution rules for offline mode)
treatment_plan: Cellular failover on the firewall; ask the processor about its offline transaction rules

threat_event: Storefront SaaS outage during a holiday peak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single storefront provider
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report states a 4-hour recovery time
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: vendor recovery commitment meets the BIA (P05 BP-02); orders taken by phone for pickup with payment at the store

threat_event: Processor or storefront vendor loses its PCI DSS compliance status without the company noticing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No list of service providers; no annual check of AOCs; processor AOC on file is from 2024
treatment_plan: Service provider list with responsibility matrix; annual AOC and SOC 2 review (P09)

threat_event: Former employee joins the corporate Wi-Fi from the parking lot using the unchanged passphrase
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Passphrase unchanged since 2023; corporate network reaches IoT devices
treatment_plan: Rotate the passphrase now and at each manager departure; move to identity-based Wi-Fi sign-in

threat_event: Card numbers that customers email to customer service stay in the mailbox and are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule, auto-reply, or detection for card numbers in email
treatment_plan: Delete the 2 emails; auto-reply warning; data loss prevention rule for card numbers in the productivity suite

threat_event: A POS software update causes receipts to print more card digits than allowed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No receipt check after POS updates
existing_controls: Receipts correct today (last 4 digits, no expiration date)
treatment_plan: Check a test receipt after every POS update

threat_event: Pricing engine vendor uses loyalty purchase data for other clients or to train shared models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract silent on data use and deletion
treatment_plan: Contract amendment: no secondary use, deletion at termination, security terms

threat_event: Pricing engine data error publishes an extreme online price
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Price bounds exist but exceptions are not reviewed
existing_controls: Prices bounded at plus or minus 15% of shelf price
treatment_plan: Daily exception report; hard floor at item cost

threat_event: Lost handheld picking device exposes customer names and delivery addresses for the day's orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Handhelds show the day's order list
existing_controls: Device PIN; app sign-in; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Denial of service against the storefront
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside company control
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Loyalty API abused to look up members' names and emails by phone number
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static API keys; lookup returns full name and email; no rate limit
existing_controls: API reachable only from the POS VLAN and storefront addresses
treatment_plan: Rate limiting; return masked name only to the POS; rotate keys every 90 days

threat_event: No logs available to scope an incident (storefront admin, cloud, identity provider)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default log retention; nobody reviews logs
treatment_plan: Export logs to 1-year storage; weekly review

threat_event: Hurricane closes the store for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written continuity plan; generator covers refrigeration only
treatment_plan: Hurricane plan with a pre-storm checklist, generator test, and online-ordering pause

threat_event: Retired storefront app with theme write permission abused to inject a script
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unused reviews app still installed with theme write access (found in P07 testing 2026-08-13)
treatment_plan: Uninstall the app; quarterly review of installed apps and their permissions
